As per item (D) 4 of Schedule III of Interconnection Regulations 207: 


“The watermarking network logo for all pay channels shall be inserted at encoder end only. 
Provided that only the encoders deployed after coming into effect of these Amendment regulations shall 
support watermarking network logo for all pay channels at the encoder end.” 


Similar provisions exist in Schedule X of Interconnection Regulations 207. 


Interconnection Regulations 20!7 mandated insertion of watermarking network logo from encoder end for pay 
channels. The main purpose of the abovementioned provision was to tackle piracy by tracing the source of signal 
which is used for piracy. This approach is necessary because a rogue entity may be able to disable or tamper with 
the logo inserted only at the STB level. However, in case of infrastructure sharing between DPOs since the encoders 
may be shared by multiple DPOs, inserting multiple watermarking of each DPO from encoders will result in 
appearance of multiple DPO logos on the end screen which will compromise the quality of the video signal viewing 
experience on the TV screen. 


Accordingly, the Authority is of the view that infrastructure providers may be mandated to insert watermarking 
network logo at only encoder end and infrastructure seeker may be permitted to provide network logo through 
STB/middleware. 


In such a scenario, if the broadcaster desires, they should be able to identify the infrastructure provider using 
broadcaster triggered fingerprint. On identifying the Infrastructure Provider source, the broadcaster may ask the 
infrastructure provider to trigger the DPO triggered fingerprint for identifying the real DPO STB ID. This 
architecture also prevents multiple logos from cluttering the video signal and avoids additional financial burdens 
associated with deploying separate encoders. 


However, to protect the interest of consumers, the Authority is of the view that multiple logo appearances on video 
signals needs to be avoided. Accordingly, not more than 2 logos — one of the broadcasters and the other of the last 
mile distributor, should preferably be visible at customer end at any time on the end screen. Logo specifications 
decision is left to the service providers. The Authority is of the view that service providers would normally 
endeavour to provide the best viewing experience to the end user. 


In view of the above, suitable provisions have been included in the Seventh Amendment Regulations. However, 
the market developments shall be monitored, and further intervention as felt necessary may be considered at 
appropriate time.

का.आ. 570(अ).--- भारत सरकार की अधिसूचना के द्वारा रेल मंत्रालय (ईस्ट कोस्ट रेलवे, निर्माण संगठन) में 
अधिसूचना संख्या, का.आ.5344(अ). दिनांक 24 नवंबर, 2025 भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग-॥, खंड-3 उप-खंड (ii) 
में प्रकाशित, दिनांक 2। नवंबर 2025 (इसके बाद उक्त अधिसूचना के रूप में संदर्भित) और उप-धारा (() के तहत जारी 
किया गया। रेलवे अधिनियम, 989 (4989 का 24) (इसके बाद उक्त अधिनियम के रूपमें संदर्भित) की धारा 20ए के तहत, 
केंद्र सरकार निष्पादन के उद्देश्यसे उक्त अधिसूचना से जुड़ी अनुसूची में विशेष रेलवे परियोजना अर्थात्‌,"खुर्दा रोड डिवीजन 
के तहत हॉवड़ा-विशाखापत्तनम मुख्य लाइन पर TAT(RBA)-SFHT(HMA) स्टेशनों के बीच KM 556/7-3 पर आर.ओ.बी 
(रोड ओवर ब्रिज) संख्या 275 का निर्माण।" के निर्माण का रखरखाव, प्रबंधन और संचालन, ओड़िशा राज्य के जिला-गंजाम 
में निर्दिष्ट भूमिका अधिग्रहण करने के अपने इरादे की घोषणा करती है। 


और, उक्त अधिसूचना का सार दैनिक स्थानीय समाचार पत्रों अर्थात्‌ ओड़िया में "धरित्री” (कटक संस्करण) में 
दिनांक 23 दिसंबर, 2025 को और अंग्रेजी में “न्यू इंडियन एक्सप्रेस” (कोलकता संस्करण) में दिनांक 23 दिसंबर, 2025 को 
उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20ए की उपधारा (4) के तहत प्रकाशित हुआथा। और जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किसी 
व्यक्ति से कोई आपत्ति प्राप्त नहीं की गई है। और, सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20ई की उपधारा (॥) के 
अनुसरण में अपनी रिपोर्ट केंद्र सरकार को सौंप दी है।

NOTIFICATION 
Bhubaneswar, the 5th February, 2026 


5.0. 570(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (East 
Coast Railway, Construction Organisation), Notification number, S.0.5344(E). dated 2‘t November, 2025 published 
in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part-II, section-3 Sub-section (ii), dated 25* November, 2025 (herein after referred 
to as the said notification) and issued under sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railways Act, 989 (24 of 989) 
(herein after referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declares its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of 
Special Railway Project, namely, “Construction of Road Over Bridge in lieu of closing of manned L.C.No.275 at Km 
556/l-3 between Rambha(RBA)-Humma(HMA) stations on Howrah—Visakhapatnam main line under Khurda Road 
Division” in the Ganjam district state of Odisha. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily local newspapers namely "DHARITRI" 
in Odia (Cuttack Edition) on dated 237 December, 2025 and “New Indian Express” in English (Kolkatta Edition) dated 
237 December, 2025 under sub-section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; and whereas no objection has been received 
from any person by the competent authority. 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government. 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers conferred by 
sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the 


schedule annexed here to shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares 
that on publication of the notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed here to shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

1947 (1947 का XLVIII) की धारा 14 के अधीन प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए भारतीय उपचर्या परिषद्‌ एतद्द्वारा 
निम्नलिखित आदेश जारी करती है:- 


जबकि, उड़ीसा राज्य में स्थित निम्नलिखित संस्थानों को राज्य सरकार तथा उड़ीसा नर्सेज एंड मिडवाइव्स काउंसिल 
द्वारा नर्सिंग पाठ्यक्रम संचालित करने के लिए मान्यता दी गई थी। 


वहीं, भारतीय उपचर्या परिषद्‌ अधिनियम, 1947 की धारा 14 के तहत मान्यता वापस लेने हेतु प्रधान सचिव (स्वास्थ्य 
एवं परिवार कल्याण), स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग, उड़ीसा सरकार, सचिवालय भवन, भुवनेष्वर-751001, उड़ीसा को 
एक नोटिस संख्या 18-24 / सरकार / 2024-आईएनसी (63695) दिनांक 08.11.2024 को जारी किया गया था। दिनांक 08.11. 
2024 को जारी नोटिस की एक प्रति उड़ीसा नर्सेज एंड मिडवाइव्स काउंसिल को भी भेजी गई थी। जारी किए गए नोटिस में, 
राज्य सरकार से नर्सिंग संस्थानों की उपयुक्तता के संबंध में अपनी सिफारिशें परिषद को प्रस्तुत करने का अनुरोध किया गया 
था। 


चूंकि, निम्नलिखित संस्थानों की उपयुक्तता के संबंध में परिषद्‌ को राज्य सरकार या उड़ीसा नर्सेज एंड मिडवाइव्स 
काउंसिल से कोई टिप्पणी या सिफारिश प्राप्त नहीं हुई है।

4947 (947 का XLVIII) की धारा 44 के अधीन प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए भारतीय उपचर्या परिषद्‌ एतद्द्वारा 
निम्नलिखित आदेश जारी करती है:- 

जबकि, हरियाणा राज्य में स्थित निम्नलिखित संस्थानों को राज्य सरकार तथा हरियाणा नर्सेज एंड मिडवाइव्स काउंसिल 
द्वारा नर्सिंग पाठ्यक्रम संचालित करने के लिए मान्यता दी गई थी। 


वहीं, भारतीय उपचर्या परिषद्‌ अधिनियम, 4947 की धारा 44 के तहत मान्यता वापस लेने हेतु प्रधान सचिव (चिकित्सा, 
स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण), स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण विभाग, हरियाणा सरकार, कमरा संख्या 402, पहली मंजिल, नया 
हरियाणा सचिवालय भवन, सेक्टर-47, चण्डीगढ़-460047, हरियाणा को एक नोटिस संख्या 48-42 / सरकार / 2024-आईएनसी 
(63643) दिनांक 46.40.2024 को जारी किया गया था। दिनांक 46.40.2024 को जारी नोटिस की एक प्रति हरियाणा नर्सेज एंड 
मिडवाइव्स काउंसिल को भी भेजी गई थी। जारी किए गए नोटिस में, राज्य सरकार से नर्सिंग संस्थानों की उपयुक्तता के संबंध 
में अपनी सिफारिशें परिषद को प्रस्तुत करने का अनुरोध किया गया था। 


चूंकि, निम्नलिखित संस्थानों की उपयुक्तता के संबंध में परिषद्‌ को राज्य सरकार या हरियाणा नर्सेज एंड मिडवाइव्स 
काउंसिल से कोई टिप्पणी या सिफारिश प्राप्त नहीं हुई है।

निम्नलिखित आदेश जारी करती है:- 


जबकि, महाराष्ट्र राज्य में स्थित निम्नलिखित संस्थानों को राज्य सरकार तथा महाराष्ट्र उपचर्या परिषद्‌ द्वारा नर्सिंग 
पाठ्यक्रम संचालित करने के लिए मान्यता दी गई थी। 


वहीं, भारतीय उपचर्या परिषद्‌ अधिनियम, .947 की धारा 44 के तहत मान्यता वापस लेने हेतु प्रधान सचिव (लोक 
स्वास्थ्य विभाग), महाराष्ट्र सरकार, दसवां तल, बी विंग, जी.टी. अस्पताल परिसर भवन, मुम्बई-400004, महाराष्ट्र को एक नोटिस 
संख्या 48-49 / सरकार / 2024-आईएनसी (63689) दिनांक 08.44.2024 को जारी किया गया था। दिनांक 08.44.2024 को 
जारी नोटिस की एक प्रति महाराष्ट्र उपचर्या परिषद्‌ को भी भेजी गई थी। जारी किए गए नोटिस में, राज्य सरकार से नर्सिंग 
संस्थानों की उपयुक्तता के संबंध में अपनी सिफारिशें परिषद को प्रस्तुत करने का अनुरोध किया गया था। 


चूंकि, निम्नलिखित संस्थानों की उपयुक्तता के संबंध में परिषद्‌ को राज्य सरकार या महाराष्ट्र उपचर्या परिषद्‌ से कोई 
टिप्पणी या सिफारिश प्राप्त नहीं हुई है। 


वहीं, परिषद्‌ ने इस मामले पर पूरी तरह से विचार किया है। भारतीय उपचर्या परिषद्‌ के तस्तावेज दर्शाते हैं कि ये 
संस्थान कई वर्षों से वैधानिक निरीक्षण के लिए आवेदन करने में विफल रहे हैं और नर्सिंग कार्यक्रम संचालित करने के लिए 
अपर्याप्त / अनुपयुक्त पाए गए हैं।

New Delhi, the 3rd February, 2026 


F. No. 8-9/Govt./2024-INC.— In exercise of the powers conferred under Section 4 of the Indian Nursing 
Council Act, 947 (XLVIII of 947), the Indian Nursing Council hereby issues the following order:— 


Whereas, the following institutions located in the State of Maharashtra were recognized by the State 
Government and the Maharashtra Nursing Council to conduct nursing courses. 


Whereas, a notice no. |8-9/Govt./2024-INC (63689) dated 08//2024 for withdrawal of recognition under 
Section 4 of the Indian Nursing Council Act, !947, was issued to the Principal Secretary (Public Health Department), 
Government of Maharashtra, |0th Floor, B Wing, G T Hospital Complex Building, Mumbai - 40000, Maharashtra. A 
copy of the notice dated 08/] [/2024 was also sent to the Maharashtra Nursing Council. In the notice issued, the State 
Government was requested to submit its recommendations to the Council regarding the suitability of the nursing 
institutions. 


Whereas, the Council has not received any remarks or recommendation from the State Government or the 
Maharashtra Nursing Council regarding the suitability of the below-mentioned institutions. 


Whereas, the Council has considered the matter in its entirety. The Indian Nursing Council records show that 
these institutions have failed to apply for statutory inspection for several years and were found deficient/unsuitable for 
conducting nursing programmes.

S.O. 625(E).— Whereas by the notification number S.0.3892(E) dated 25th August, 2025 of the Government

Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3(A) of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning, etc.), 
Maintenance, management and operation of National Highway-731K in the stretch of land from Km. 0.000 to 
Km. 47.026 (Shahjahanpur-Bisalpur section) in the district of PILIBHIT in the state of UTTAR PRADESH. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Umar Ujala” (Hindi) and “Hindustan 
Times” (English) both dated 20 September, 2025 under sub-section (3) of section 3(A) of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by 
the Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3(D) of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3(D) of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3(D) of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest

New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 
9.0. 590(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, Notification number S.0.402(E) dated 02/09/2025, published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part 
II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highways Act, 956 (48 of 
956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening / Two /four laning etc.), 


maintenance, management and operation of National Highway 66H in the stretch of land Km 0.00 to km 
29/600 (Peth Naka - Karandwadi) in the district of Sangli in the state of Maharashtra. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification S.0.402I(E) dated 02/09/2025, has been published in 
“Lalkar” and “Satyadut” Both Dated 07/0/2025; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 591(अ).-- केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2102(E) तारीख 09/05/2025, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Ul, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा गुजरात राज्य के जामनगर जिले में NH927D के 
कि.मी. 3.665 से कि.मी.72.2 तक के भूखण्ड पर टोल प्लाजा के निर्माण, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस 
अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "20/05/2025 को 
“द इंडियन एक्सप्रेस [इंग्लिश]? , 20/05/2025 को “नोबत” " में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 591(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2102(E) Dated:09/05/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance, management and operation of NH927D in 
the stretch of land from Km. 3.665 to Km. 72.2 in the district of JAMNAGAR in the state of GUJARAT 


14 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(11)] 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Indian Express” dated 
20/05/2025 , “Nobat” dated 20/05/2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 


conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

राजमार्ग खंड का प्रयोग करने के लिए तब तक हकदार नहीं होगा जब तक ऐसे यांत्रिक वाहन से लदा अतिभार हटाया नहीं जाता।

8. फीस की दरें उक्त नियमों के नियम 12 के अनुसरण में प्रयोक्ताओं के सूचनार्थ प्रदर्शित करनी होंगी। 


9. यांत्रिक वाहनों से फीस की वास्तविक राशि उपर्युक्त तालिका-1 में यथा-उल्लिखित आधार वर्ष 2007-08 के लिए प्रति 
किमी फीस की आधार दर के आधार पर प्रभारित होगी और छूटों की गणना भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण द्वारा खंड की पूरी हो 
गई लंबाई के आधार पर की जाएगी और उसे उक्त नियमों के नियम 5 के अनुसार प्रति वर्ष संशोधित किया जाएगा तथा तदनुसार उसे 
अंग्रेजी और क्षेत्रीय भाषा के कम से कम एक-एक समाचार पत्र में प्रकाशित किया जाएगा। 


10. इस परियोजना की प्राक्कलित पूंजीगत लागत 5689.76 करोड़ रु. है। भूमि अधिग्रहण, जन उपयोगी सुविधाओं के 
स्थानांतरण, पेड़ों को काटने, आदि कार्यकलापों को अभी पूरा किया जाना है इसलिए, पूंजीगत लागत परिवर्तन के अध्यधीन है। प्राप्त 
प्रयोक्ता फीस के माध्यम से वसूल की गई पूंजीगत लागत का भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण द्वारा रिकार्ड रखा जाएगा।

का.आ. 660(अ).--रेलवे (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 1989 (89 का 24) (इसके बाद उक्त अधिनियम के रूप में 
संदर्भित) की धारा बीस (ए) की उप-धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, केंद्र सरकार, इस बात से संतुष्ट होने 
के बाद कि सार्वजनिक उद्देश्य के लिए भूमि, जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण इसके साथ संलग्न अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ओडिशा 
राज्य के खुर्दा जिले में विशेष रेलवे परियोजना, अर्थात, “ओडिशा और आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य में पूर्व तट रेलवे के खुर्दा रोड और 
वाल्टेयर डिवीज़न के अंतर्गत भद्रक - विजयनगरम (५२५ कि मि) के बीच नई स्वीकृत तृतीय रेलवे लाइन परियोजना के 
तहत निर्गुन्डी - बारंग (२२ कि मि) और खुर्दा रोड - विजयनगरम (३६३ कि मि) के बीच तृतीय रेलवे लाइन“ के निर्माण के 
लिए आवश्यक है, एतद्वारा ऐसी भूमि का अधिग्रहण करने के अपने इरादे की घोषणा करता है। 


उक्त भूमि में रुचि रखने वाला कोई भी व्यक्ति आधिकारिक राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से 
तीस दिनों की अवधि के भीतर, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा बीस (डी) की उप-धारा (एक) के तहत उक्त उद्देश्य के लिए ऐसी 
भूमि के अधिग्रहण पर आपत्ति उठा सकता है। 


प्रत्येक आपत्ति, सक्षम प्राधिकारी अर्थात भूमि अधिग्रहण अधिकारी, खुर्दा, राज्य - ओडिशा को लिखित रूप में की 
जाएगी जिसमें इसका कारण दर्शाया जायेगा, और सक्षम प्राधिकारी आपत्ति कर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप से या किसी कानूनी 
व्यवसायी के माध्यम से सुनवाई किए जाने का मौका देगा, और ऐसी सभी आपत्तियों को सुनने के बाद और आगे की जरूरी

Notice under Section 204 of the Railways Act — 1989 


S.O. 660(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways 
(Amendment) Act, 1989 (24/89) (here in after referred as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied 
that for the public purpose, the Land, brief description of which is given in the schedule annexed here to, is required in 
Khurda district of Odisha state for the execution of the Special Railway Project, namely “3rd line between Nirgundi — 
Barang (22 Km) & Khurda Road - Vizianagaram (363 Kms) of newly sanctioned 3rd line between Bhadrak-

and Andhra Pradesh.” hereby declares its intention to acquire such land.

notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub- 
section (1) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely Land Acquisition Officer, Khurda, State - 
Odisha for “3rd line between Nirgundi — Barang (22 Km) & Khurda Road - Vizianagaram (363 Kms) of newly 
sanctioned 3rd line between Bhadrak-Vizianagarm project (525Km)” under Khurda Road and Waltair Division of East 
Coast Railway in the State of Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.” in writing and shall set out grounds thereof, and competent 
authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or through a legal practitioner, and may, 
after hearing all such objections and after making such further inquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks 
necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 


by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5239 तारीख 47/44/2025, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, 
भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) H प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के महोबा जिले में NH34 के कि.मी. 87.9 से 
कि.मी.226.3 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन 
के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 76/42/2025 को “दर्शन

उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 60(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 5239 Dated:7//2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of |956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH34 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 87.9 to Km. 226.3 in the district of MAHOBA in the state of UTTAR PRADESH; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Darshan Post” and “Amar Ujala” 
both dated 6/2/2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 623(अ).-- केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4128 तारीख 11/09/2025, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा महाराष्ट्र राज्य के कोल्हापूर जिले में NH-166 के 
कि.मी. 67.140 से कि.मी.145.300(रत्वागिरी-कोल्हापूर सेक्शन) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने / चार 
लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 09.10.2025 को 
"टाईम्स ऑफ इंडिया (अंग्रेजी) और "दैनिक लोकमत " (मराठी) दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 623(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 4128 Dated:11/09/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH-166 in the stretch of land from Km. 67.140 to Km. 145.300 (Ratnagiri-Kolhapur Section ) in the district of 
KOLHAPUR in the state of MAHARASHTRA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in "Daily Lokmat" in Marathi dtd 
09.10.2025 And "Daily Times Of India" in English dtd 09.10.2025; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said 
Act; 

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 


conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4303 तारीख 23/09/2025, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग 
|, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के रीवा जिले में |॥1३39 के कि.मी. 239.4 से 
कि.मी.246 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधत और प्रचालन के 
लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 05/10/2025 को 
"दैनिक भास्कर" और "द हितवाद" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप से

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 602(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 4303 Dated:23/09/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH39 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 239.4 to Km. 246 in the district of REWA in the state of MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Bhaskar” and “The 
Hitavada” both dated 05.10.2025; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 608(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O. 3282(E), published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued 
under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said 
Act) on 18th July, 2025 the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building National Highways 152G from Jalbahera (near Ismailabad from Km. 
0+000) to Patti kankra (Near Shahbad Km. 22+850) in district Kurukshetra in the state of Haryana. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Bhaskar” and “The 
Tribune” both dated 26 July, 2025 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas no objection has been received from any person by the competent authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 609(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4730 तारीख 17/10/2025, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा तेलंगाना राज्य के निज़ामाबाद जिले में |॥163 के 
कि.मी. 29.1 से कि.मी. 55 (आरमूर - जागतियाल - मांचेरियाल विभाग) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने 
/ चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट 
भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 26/10/2025 को 
“थे टाइम्स ओएफ इंडिया [इंग्लिश]|” , 26/10/2025 को “नमस्ते तेलंगाना” दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 609(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. 4730 Dated:17/10/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH63 in the stretch of land from Km. 29.1 to Km. 55 (Armoor - Jagitial - Mancherial Section) in the 
district of NIZAMABAD in the state of TELANGANA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India” dated 
26/10/2025 , “Namastey Telangana” dated 26/10/2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


12 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(11)] 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4994(ई) दिनांक 02 मई, 2025 (जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिसूचना कहा गया है), द्वारा उक्त अधिसूचना 
से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि को विशेष रेल परियोजना अर्थात्‌ आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के नंद्याल जिले में महबूबनगर - 
डोन दोहरीकरण के निष्पादन, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और परिचालन के लिए आपेक्षित है, एतदद्वारा ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने 
के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी;

था; 


और जबकि, नंद्याल जिले के डोन मंडल के कामगानिकुंट्ला और डोन गांवों के लिए कोई आपत्तियां प्राप्त नहीं हुई हैं 
तथा सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा विचारोपरांत तदनुसार आदेश पारित किए गए हैं;

भूमि पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जित की जाएगी; 


अत: अब केंद्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी से उक्त रिपोर्ट के प्राप्त होने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20(ई) 
की उप-धारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट 


और यह कि केंद्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20ई की उप-धारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है 
कि आधिकारिक राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशित होने पर इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विलंगमों 
से मुक्त होकर केंद्रीय सरकार में आत्यांकित रूप से निहित हो जाएगी.

Secunderabad, the 6th February, 2026 


99.0. 66I(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways 
(Railway Board) Number S.O 994(E) dated the 0274 May’2025 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part IJ, 
section 3 Sub-section(ii), dated the 0274 May, 2025 (hereinafter referred to as the said notification) and issued under 
sub-section(l) of section 20(A) of the Railway Act, 989 (24 of 989), the Central Government declared its intention 
to acquire the land specified in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution, 
maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely Mahabubnagar — Dhone doubling 
project in the District of NANDYAL in the State of Andhra Pradesh. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “THE HANS 
INDIA, HINDI MILAP, SAAKSHI and ABN Andhra Jyothi” dated gt May’2025 under sub section(4) of section 
20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, for Somapuram H/o Kamaganikuntla & Dhone Villages of Dhone Mandal, Nandyal district, 
no objections were received and the same have been considered by the competent Authority accordingly orders have 
been passed; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section () of 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted 
its report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub-section () of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in 
the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government here by 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed here 
to shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances:

पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (4) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 972 तारीख 0/05/2025, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Ul, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) F प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के शामली जिले में NH 709 A 
के कि.मी. 26.65 से कि.मी.90 (मेरठ से हरियाणा बॉर्डर वाया शामली खण्ड) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा 
करने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में 
विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "47.05.2025 " 
को "हिन्दुस्तान" और "दी टाईम्स ऑफ इण्डिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 63(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 972 Dated:0/05/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed 
to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH 709 
A in the stretch of land from Km. 26.65 to Km. 90 (Meerut to Haryana Border via Shamli Section) in the district of 
SHAMLI in the state of UTTAR PRADESH. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan” and “The Times of 
India” both dated 7.05.2025 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 595(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2787(E) Dated:12/07/2021, 4602(E) Dated:17/10/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to 
acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance, 
management and operation of NH51 in the stretch of land from Km. 38.2 to Km. 85.118 in the district of 
SURENDRANAGAR in the state of GUJARAT. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Indian Express” dated 
19/11/2025 , “SANDESH” dated 19/11/2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 622(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 4796 Dated:22/0/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part H, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH30 in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 23.5 in the district of PATNA in the state of BIHAR 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India” dated 
2//2025 , “Hindustan” dated 2//2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 


settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 605(अ).--- केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क परिवहन 
और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4127 तारीख 11/09/2025, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, 
भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा बिहार राज्य के शेखपुरा जिले में NH8O के कि.मी. 20.7 से 
कि.मी. 23.3 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन 
के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 05/12/2025 को 
“दैनिक जागरण ” , 05/12/2025 को “प्रभात खबर” दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(11)] 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त

New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 605(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 4127 Dated:11/09/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH80 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 20.7 to Km. 23.3 in the district of SHEIKHPURA in the state of BIHAR 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Jagran” dated 05/12/2025 , 
“Prabhat Khabar” dated 05/12/2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 606(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 3721 Dated:13/08/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH80 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 66.3 to Km. 81 in the district of MUNGER in the state of BIHAR 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan Times” dated 29/08/2025 
, ‘Dainik Jagran” dated 29/08/2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

Under clause 20A of the Railway (Amendment) Act 2008 
5.0. 584(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of Section 20 (A) of the Railways 
Act, 989 (24 of 989) (hereinafter referred to the Railway (Amendment) Act 2008 (No.I] of 2008), the Central 
Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been given in 
schedule annexed hereto, is required for purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special 
Railway Project, namely Kalyan-Asangaon 4" line in the District of Thane in the State of Maharashtra, hereby declares 


its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this notification 
in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under Sub-Section 
() of section 20 D of the said Act.

making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 


objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under Sub-Section (2) of Section 20 D of the said Act shall be final.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 6th February, 2026 


S.O. 607(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, Number S.O. 4878 (E) Dated 24/0/2025, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 
3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder etc.,), 
maintenance, management and operation of NH-3 in the stretch of land from Km. 50.900 to Km. 203.300 in 
the district of PRATAPGARH in the state of UTTAR PRADESH; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in Hindi “Hindustan” and English “The 
Timse of India” both dated 0//2025, under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas no objection has been received from any person by the Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
